name: 收获规格与价格关系分析器

map.按规格-价格档位分析收益，结合生长率与饲料成本寻找最佳上市规格: Analyze returns by size-price tier and find the best market size from growth rate and feed cost.
map.📖 查看「延迟上市规格—价格净收益分析使用指南」: 📖 View the "Delayed-Harvest Size-Price Net Return Analysis Guide"
map.规格价格 = 均重×单价: Size price = average weight × unit price
map.规格-价格档位（体重g → 单价元/kg）: Size-price tiers (body weight g → unit price CNY/kg)
map.规格价格线性插值；存塘鱼数=存塘量×1000÷均重；长至目标规格新增产量=鱼数×: Linear interpolation of the size price; number of fish = standing stock × 1000 ÷ average weight; extra yield from growing to the target size = fish number × (target weight - current weight) ÷ 1000; days needed = ln(target weight / current weight) × 100 ÷ SGR; extra feed = extra yield × FCR; net return comparison = delayed-harvest revenue - current-harvest revenue - feed cost.
map.📚 深度解析：延迟上市规格—价格净收益分析: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Delayed-Harvest Size-Price Net Return Analysis
map.比较『现在按当前规格卖』与『继续养到更大规格卖』的净收益，辅助出塘决策。: Compare the net return of selling now at the current size with growing on to a larger size, to support the harvest decision.
map.按价格阶梯（规格越大单价越高）与 SGR、FCR 推算新增产量、所需天数与饲料成: Estimate the extra yield, days needed and feed cost from the price ladder (larger size, higher unit price), SGR and FCR.
map.选出延迟净收益最大的目标规格档位。: Pick the target size tier with the largest delayed net return.
map.1000 kg、500 g/尾、延迟到 800 g 的净收益示意: Net return illustration for 1000 kg, 500 g/fish delayed to 800 g
map.示意（按实际价格阶梯与参数）：尾数 = 1000×1000/500 = 2000: Illustration (using the actual price ladder and parameters): number of fish = 1000×1000/500 = 2000; at a target of 800 g the extra yield = 2000×(800-500)/1000 = 600 kg; at an SGR of 2%/day it takes about 23.5 days; extra feed = 600×FCR(assume 1.5) = 900 kg, costing about 7200 CNY; if the unit price is 16 at 500 g and 20 CNY/kg at 800 g, the extra revenue is about 32000-16000 = 16000 CNY and the net return about 8800 CNY, so this tier is worth delaying for. In practice refer to the price ladder you enter in this tool.
map.为什么要算净收益而非只看单价？: Why compute net return instead of just the unit price?
map.大规格单价高但要多喂料、多占塘、多担风险，净收益才是决策依据。: A larger size commands a higher unit price but needs more feed, more pond space and more risk, so the net return is the basis for the decision.
map.饲料系数 FCR 影响多大？: How much does the feed conversion ratio FCR matter?
map.FCR 越高，延迟的饲料成本越大，净收益越低；低 FCR 品种更适合延迟上市。: The higher the FCR, the greater the feed cost of delaying and the lower the net return; species with a low FCR are better suited to delayed harvest.
map.收获规格与价格关系分析器 - 分析不同收获规格的价格与收益，结合生长与饲料成本寻: Harvest Size-Price Relationship Analyzer - analyzes the price and return of different harvest sizes and finds the best market timing from growth and feed cost, an online fishery and aquaculture tool. A fishery and aquaculture tool that helps calculate farming parameters and yields.
